title: Bial Foundation as the biggest funder of parapsychology
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Bial Foundation as the biggest funder of parapsychology, about present at Portugal, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Rupert Sheldrake, a biologist, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that the biggest funder of parapsychology, the study of things like telepathy and other psychic abilities, is the Bial Foundation in Portugal. He says about half of its grants go to parapsychology research, which would make it a key supporter of a field that gets little money elsewhere.
